title: Natural Language Processing: from text to reliable language systems
summary: 24 lessons in natural language processing, from text representation and linguistic structure to classical models, neural methods and careful evaluation. Continue into LLM mechanisms and subject assistants when ready.

lessons.title: Language as data and the unit of analysis
lessons.outcome: Explain and implement language as data and the unit of analysis with inspectable data and measured errors.
lessons.lab: Use a small authored corpus to trace the calculation, compare a baseline and inspect counterexamples.
lessons.verification: Check numerical or span-level expected results, perturb input assumptions and interpret the observed errors.
